mapper.select: SELECT q.id AS question_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_answer a WHERE a.owner_id=q.owner_id AND a.session_id=q.session_id AND a.question_id=q.id) AS answer_count, (SELECT a.id FROM training_answer a WHERE a.owner_id=q.owner_id AND a.session_id=q.session_id AND a.question_id=q.id ORDER BY a.version_number DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_answer_id FROM training_question q WHERE q.owner_id=#{owner} AND q.session_id=#{sessionId} ORDER BY q.position_index
SELECT title FROM training_question WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND id=#{questionId}

SELECT a.id AS answer_id,a.version_number AS number,a.created_at,a.answer_condition AS `condition`,a.exposure_json, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_evaluation_access x WHERE x.owner_id=a.owner_id AND x.session_id=a.session_id AND x.question_id=a.question_id AND x.answer_id=a.id) AS access_allowed,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_feedback f JOIN review_feedback_revision r ON r.owner_id=f.owner_id AND r.feedback_id=f.id AND r.revision=f.revision WHERE f.owner_id=a.owner_id AND f.session_id=a.session_id AND f.question_id=a.question_id AND f.answer_id=a.id AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.content_json,'$.kind'))='SELF_CHECK') AS self_check_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_feedback f JOIN review_feedback_revision r ON r.owner_id=f.owner_id AND r.feedback_id=f.id AND r.revision=f.revision WHERE f.owner_id=a.owner_id AND f.session_id=a.session_id AND f.question_id=a.question_id AND f.answer_id=a.id AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.content_json,'$.kind'))='EXTERNAL_FEEDBACK') AS external_feedback_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FROM review_action_source s WHERE s.owner_id=a.owner_id AND s.session_id=a.session_id AND s.question_id=a.question_id AND s.answer_id=a.id) AS action_source_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) FROM review_action_source s WHERE s.owner_id=a.owner_id AND s.session_id=a.session_id AND s.question_id=a.question_id AND s.answer_id=a.id AND s.tracking='TRACKING') AS tracking_source_count FROM training_answer a WHERE a.owner_id=#{owner} AND a.session_id=#{sessionId} AND a.question_id=#{questionId} AND a.version_number < #{before} ORDER BY a.version_number DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.answer_id,t.id,t.status,t.revision,t.updated_at,t.error_code FROM ai_evaluation e JOIN ai_task t ON t.owner_id=e.owner_id AND t.id=e.task_id WHERE e.owner_id=#{owner} AND e.session_id=#{sessionId} AND e.question_id=#{questionId} AND t.purpose='ANSWER_EVALUATION' AND e.answer_id IN #{answerId} ORDER BY e.answer_id,t.created_at,t.id
